title: Signals connect button disabled two sec after script edit
body: ### Tested versions Reproduced in: v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da] v4.6.2.rc1.official [257ac3532] v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory ### Issue description The signals panel's bottom `Connect...` button, becomes disabled, two seconds after interacting with a script: - attach a script to the selected node - open the attached script - modify the script: type/erase/undo/redo It's just the `Connect...` button that becomes disabled. The selected signal can still be connected by: - right-clicking and choosing `Connect...` - double-clicking Workaround: The `Connect...` button becomes enabled when another signal is selected. Then the initially selected signal can be selected again and the `Connect...` remains enabled, until the script is modified again. Expected: Keep the `Connect...` button enabled, when editing a script. ### Steps to reproduce - open the project: [signals connect button disabled on script edit.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26110996/signals.connect.button.disabled.on.script.edit.zip) - in the scene panel, select `Node2D` - in the signals panel, select a signal, ex the first: `draw()` - note that the bottom right button: `Connect...` is enabled, it has a mouse over effect - click `Connect...`, it opens the dialog: `Connect a Signal to a Method` - close the dialog, press: `esc` - with a signal still selected, ex: `draw()` - in the scene panel, open the selected node's attached script: `node_2d.gd` Issue: After about two seconds, the signal panel's bottom `Connect...` button becomes disabled (darker button colors, no mouse over effect, it can't be clicked). The `Connect...` button also becomes disabled, two seconds after modifying a script: typing/erasing/undo/redo Expected: Keep the `Connect...` button enabled, when editing a script. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [signals connect button disabled on script edit.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26110996/signals.connect.button.disabled.on.script.edit.zip)
